SELECT FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application a INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger l ON l.ledger_id = a.ledger_id AND l.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_member m ON m.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND m.member_id = a.member_id AND m.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application original ON original.invoice_application_id = a.original_application_id AND original.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_record ir ON ir.invoice_application_id = a.invoice_application_id AND ir.is_delete = 0 WHERE a.application_no = #{applicationNo} AND a.is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT a.invoice_application_id AS applicationId, a.tenant_id AS tenantId, a.member_id AS memberId, a.ledger_id AS ledgerId, a.application_no AS applicationNo, a.idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, a.application_type AS applicationType, a.application_status AS applicationStatus, a.invoice_type AS invoiceType, a.invoice_title AS invoiceTitle, a.tax_no AS taxNo, a.invoice_email AS invoiceEmail, a.amount, a.ref_type AS refType, a.ref_id AS refId, a.original_application_id AS originalApplicationId, a.original_invoice_record_id AS originalInvoiceRecordId, a.review_remark AS reviewRemark, l.ledger_no AS ledgerNo, l.invoice_status AS invoiceStatus, ir.invoice_record_id AS invoiceRecordId, ir.record_status AS invoiceRecordStatus, original_ir.invoice_no AS originalInvoiceNo FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application a INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger l ON l.ledger_id = a.ledger_id AND l.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_record ir ON ir.invoice_application_id = a.invoice_application_id AND ir.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_record original_ir ON original_ir.invoice_record_id = a.original_invoice_record_id AND original_ir.is_delete = 0 WHERE a.application_no = #{applicationNo} AND a.is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT ledger_id AS ledgerId, tenant_id AS tenantId, member_id AS memberId, ledger_no AS ledgerNo, ref_type AS refType, ref_id AS refId, invoice_status AS invoiceStatus FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger WHERE ledger_id = #{ledgerId} AND is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT ir.invoice_record_id AS invoiceRecordId, ir.invoice_application_id AS applicationId, ir.invoice_no AS invoiceNo, ir.ledger_id AS ledgerId FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_record ir INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application ia ON ia.invoice_application_id = ir.invoice_application_id AND ia.is_delete = 0 WHERE ir.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ir.member_id = #{memberId} AND ir.record_status = 1 AND ir.is_delete = 0 AND (ir.ledger_id = #{ledgerId} OR (ia.ref_type = #{refType} AND ia.ref_id = #{refId} AND #{refType} IS NOT NULL AND #{refId} IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY ir.invoice_record_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT invoice_record_id AS invoiceRecordId, tenant_id AS tenantId, member_id AS memberId, invoice_application_id AS applicationId, ledger_id AS ledgerId, invoice_no AS invoiceNo, record_status AS recordStatus FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_record WHERE invoice_record_id = #{invoiceRecordId} AND is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application a INNER JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger l ON l.ledger_id = a.ledger_id AND l.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_member m ON m.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND m.member_id = a.member_id AND m.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application original ON original.invoice_application_id = a.original_application_id AND original.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_record ir ON ir.invoice_application_id = a.invoice_application_id AND ir.is_delete = 0 WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.member_id = #{memberId} AND a.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND a.is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application (tenant_id, member_id, ledger_id, application_no, idempotency_key, application_type, application_status, invoice_type, invoice_title, tax_no, invoice_email, amount, ref_type, ref_id, original_application_id, original_invoice_record_id, review_remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{ledgerId}, #{applicationNo}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{applicationType}, #{applicationStatus}, #{invoiceType}, #{invoiceTitle}, #{taxNo}, #{invoiceEmail}, #{amount}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{originalApplicationId}, #{originalInvoiceRecordId}, #{reviewRemark}, #{operatorId}, NOW(), #{operatorId}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_application SET application_status = #{applicationStatus}, review_remark = #{reviewRemark}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_time = NOW(), update_by = #{reviewerId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE invoice_application_id = #{applicationId} AND is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_record (tenant_id, member_id, invoice_application_id, ledger_id, invoice_no, invoice_code, file_url, record_status, issued_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{applicationId}, #{ledgerId}, #{invoiceNo}, #{invoiceCode}, #{fileUrl}, 1, NOW(), #{operatorId}, NOW(), #{operatorId}, NOW(), 0)

INSERT INTO ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_red_flush (tenant_id, member_id, original_invoice_record_id, invoice_application_id, red_flush_no, reason, red_flush_status, reviewer_id, review_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{originalInvoiceRecordId}, #{applicationId}, #{redFlushNo}, #{reason}, 1, #{reviewerId}, NOW(), #{reviewerId}, NOW(), #{reviewerId}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE ry_rental.ry_rental_invoice_record SET record_status = #{recordStatus}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE invoice_record_id = #{invoiceRecordId} AND record_status = 1 AND is_delete = 0
